unit_label: BRBL C U05: Choose reconstruction measures subject to statutory, contractual and RBI constraints

facts.statement: Section9 measures include management change/takeover, business sale/lease, rescheduling, enforcement, settlement, possession and debt-equity conversion; measures subject to law and RBI policy. Section10 permits specified agency/manager/receiver roles, with pecuniary-liability constraint for manager and other-business restrictions.

payload.title: A menu of measures is not permission to skip their conditions
payload.core_explanation_md:
Reconstruction can use more than a collateral sale. Section 9 describes measures such as restructuring management, sale or lease of business, rescheduling, settlement, enforcement, possession and conversion of debt into borrower-company shares. Select a measure for its purpose and then verify the relevant contractual rights, statutory conditions and RBI policy requirements. A listed measure is not a universal power over uncharged assets.

Section 10 separately describes agency, manager and court/Tribunal-appointed receiver roles. The stated manager role must not create pecuniary liability for the ARC. Other business and resolution-applicant permissions need their own applicable approval/conditions. Do not merge these roles into a claim that an ARC can conduct any business it chooses.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a measure appearing in section 9 remove all contractual and regulatory checks?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The operative conditions and applicable RBI directions still govern it.

payload.stem_md: A reconstruction proposal offers rescheduling and debt-equity conversion as alternatives to immediate sale. What should the legal review establish?

options.text_md: Every alternative is automatically prohibited because only sale is permitted
options.explanation_md: Section9 describes a broader set of reconstruction measures.

options.text_md: Listed measures need no contractual or regulatory checks
options.explanation_md: The powers remain subject to the applicable constraints.

options.text_md: Debt-equity conversion always proves a cash recovery
options.explanation_md: A conversion and cash realisation are different transactions.

options.text_md: The selected measure, available rights and applicable statutory/RBI conditions
options.explanation_md: A legitimate measure still requires a valid basis and compliant execution.

payload.correct_explanation_md: A legitimate measure still requires a valid basis and compliant execution.

payload.stem_md: An ARC is offered a management appointment that would impose the pecuniary liability prohibited for the described section10 manager role. Which response follows the constraint?

options.text_md: Accept because every manager role is free of restrictions
options.explanation_md: The provision includes an express pecuniary-liability constraint.

options.text_md: Examine and decline or redesign the role if it violates that statutory condition
options.explanation_md: The appointment must fit the permitted function and its conditions.

options.text_md: Treat the manager as automatically owning every borrower asset
options.explanation_md: Management is not automatic ownership of all property.

options.text_md: Use a private letter to eliminate every statutory restriction
options.explanation_md: Private wording does not override the statutory role limits.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The appointment must fit the permitted function and its conditions.
